entries.title: Personnel firewall for Seaside Hotels engagement
entries.summary: AtliQ must ensure that personnel who have had access to Al Noor's Client Data under the MSA do not have access to Seaside Hotels LLC data during the performance of the Seaside SOW.
entries.quote: In performing the Seaside SOW, the Supplier shall not use or disclose any Confidential Information of the Client, and shall ensure that personnel who have had access to Client Data under the Agreement do not have access to Seaside data save with the Client's prior written approval.

relatedClauses.quote: This consent is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW. It does not extend to (a) any other services provided to Seaside, including any extension, renewal, change order or follow-on statement of work, unless separately consented to in writing by the Client; (b) any other Hospitality Business, whether in the Sultanate of Oman or elsewhere in the GCC; or (c) any Affiliate of the Supplier.

Pursuant to Clause 12.4 of the Agreement, the Client hereby consents to the Supplier providing demand-forecasting services to Seaside Hotels LLC, Muscat, Oman ("Seaside"), solely as described in the statement of work between the Supplier and Seaside dated February 2026 (the "Seaside SOW"), a copy of which has been provided to the Client.

entries.endRule: During the performance of the Seaside SOW
entries.notes: This letter waives a restriction in Clause 12 of the Master Services Agreement dated 15 March 2025 to permit AtliQ to provide demand-forecasting services to Seaside Hotels LLC, subject to a strict personnel firewall regarding Client Data.
